Fill in the prescribed form addressed to the Collector and Chairman, District Setu Committee, Gadchiroli, writing the centre name from the vacancy list.
Attach self-attested copies of certificates and the self-declaration form.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Minimum Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSC) examination passed; Basic knowledge of computers required; MSCIT or equivalent certificate will be given preference; Resident of the concerned taluka; Aadhaar number, PAN, bank account and required identity card available; Not convicted of moral turpitude, financial fraud or cyber crime Age limit: Minimum 18 years (as on the closing date) Other conditions: Must be a resident of the concerned taluka Preference, other things being equal, to a resident of the concerned village, then gram panchayat area, then revenue circle Basic computer knowledge required; MSCIT or equivalent preferred Aadhaar number, PAN, bank account and identity card must be available Must not be convicted of moral turpitude, financial fraud or cyber crime Desirable: MSCIT or equivalent certificate Experience of Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra, CSC or computer work

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Collector Office Gadchiroli Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Those submitting false or fabricated documents Those blacklisted under any government scheme Those with pending serious cases of financial fraud or cyber crime

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment fully contractual; no government servant status Tenure initially 11 months or as per committee's requirement Extension of contract on satisfactory performance at the institution's decision No right to regular or permanent government service Contract may be terminated without notice for misconduct, negligence, breach of confidentiality, absence or unsatisfactory work

rows.event: Last date for submission at Tahsil Office, Bhamragad (up to 5.00 PM)

content_sections.heading: How Will Collector Office Gadchiroli Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Structured interview by the selection committee Interview assesses knowledge of government services and citizen-oriented service attitude Interview assesses ability to handle digital systems and problem-solving ability Interview assesses communication skill, honesty and ethics Interview assesses awareness of information confidentiality and data security Selection may include scrutiny, computer skill test, written exam and/or interview; committee's decision final

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Aadhaar card PAN card Educational documents (12th / degree / post-graduation) Residence proof (domicile certificate / house tax receipt / water bill / ration card / electricity bill) Police character verification certificate

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Collector Office Gadchiroli Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Obtain the application form and the list of 4 Mini Setu Kendras from www.gadchiroli.gov.in. Fill in the prescribed form addressed to the Collector and Chairman, District Setu Committee, Gadchiroli, writing the centre name from the vacancy list. Attach self-attested copies of certificates and the self-declaration form. Submit the complete application at the Tahsil Office, Bhamragad during office hours from 17-11-2026 to 27-11-2026, up to 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Collector Office Gadchiroli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Collector Office Gadchiroli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies for Center Operator.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Collector Office Gadchiroli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed form in this notice (pages 7-9) and on www.gadchiroli.gov.in) and send it to Tahsil Office, Bhamragad, by by hand or post, to reach by 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years (as on the closing date).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Consolidated honorarium Rs 8,000.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Minimum HSC (12th) passed; basic computer knowledge required, MSCIT or equivalent certificate preferred; resident of the concerned taluka.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a resident of the concerned taluka. Preference, other things being equal, to a resident of the concerned village, then gram panchayat area, then revenue circle. Basic computer knowledge required; MSCIT or equivalent preferred. Aadhaar number, PAN, bank account and identity card must be available.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Those submitting false or fabricated documents. Those blacklisted under any government scheme. Those with pending serious cases of financial fraud or cyber crime.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Structured interview by the selection committee. Interview assesses knowledge of government services and citizen-oriented service attitude. Interview assesses ability to handle digital systems and problem-solving ability. Interview assesses communication skill, honesty and ethics.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment fully contractual; no government servant status. Tenure initially 11 months or as per committee's requirement. Extension of contract on satisfactory performance at the institution's decision.
